scope: One qualified C60 defect input; two seeds are paired probes, not independent structural validation.

definitions.full_direction: existing recovered pair/group/local/displacement controller plus recovered CBD; replaces the separate recovered_rotation route.
definitions.event_counts: qualified landing observations from analyze_escape.events; not unique minima.
definitions.best: lowest Ih-relative energy among qualified checked endpoints, explicitly including the initial structure; target, cage and Ih flags are reported separately.
definitions.missing_and_failures: missing arms, run status, record statuses, fresh failures, request denials and total costs are retained where saved.
definitions.prefix_boundary: minimum completed/charged search request count of the pair; fresh validation costs correspond to each full run.

comparison.interpretation: Prefix outcomes are retrospective from saved landings; fresh checks and total cost were paid for the completed arm, not at the prefix.
